name: clawsec-ps-fuzz
description: Harness-neutral, approval-gated provisioning and redacted direct-model fuzzing with the pinned Prompt Security ps-fuzz release.
author: prompt-security

files.description: Pinned upstream ps-fuzz attribution and license notice
Skill metadata and software bill of materials
Pinned upstream tag, commit, wheel URL, and hash
Standalone signed-release verifier and atomic installer
Offline package metadata and documentation contract tests
Offline runner boundary tests with fake executables
Offline signed-release verification and safe-install behavior tests

execution.persistence: No hooks, scheduler, proxy, or platform runtime integration. Provisioning state and redacted reports are created only after explicit command flags and caller-selected external paths.
execution.network_egress: Preflight makes no network calls. Provisioning downloads only a pinned release wheel or clones only a pinned commit after explicit authorization. Runs contact only the explicitly approved direct-model origins.

operator_review: Obtain a fresh authorization ID and the matching confirmation flag before every provision and active run.
Confirm the exact direct model provider, model, endpoint origin, attack selectors, attempts, threads, and expected token cost before a run.
Do not treat rag_poisoning as evidence about a real retrieval system, vector store, agent tools, or persistence.
